achievements.name: Visit the developers
achievements.description: Open the 'Developers' credits from the main menu and watch them all the way through (about 3 minutes).

achievements.name: Whoops
achievements.description: Destroy 1 000 000 voxels.

achievements.name: Couch potato
achievements.description: Destroy the treadmill in your home hub's gym 10 times (break it, restart the level, repeat).

achievements.name: Sharpshooter
achievements.description: Get full score on skeetmaster 10 times.

achievements.name: Average looter
achievements.description: Find 100 valuables.

achievements.name: Drive for treasure
achievements.description: On Muratori Beach (the map before the 'Alarm system' mission), open the submerged shipping container and get into the car inside - missable once 'Alarm system' is complete.

achievements.name: Paintjob
achievements.description: On the Quilez Security map, find the hidden cave containing a boat and spray-paint the boat completely.

achievements.name: Above and beyond
achievements.description: Reach an altitude of 100m.

achievements.name: Liftoff
achievements.description: Get airtime of 2 seconds in a car.

achievements.name: McFly
achievements.description: Reach 88 mph in a vehicle (easiest with rocket boosters on a long straight, e.g. the Villa Gordon racetrack).

achievements.name: I was on a boat
achievements.description: In Sandbox mode at the Marina, completely sink the largest luxury yacht (holes in the hull or heavy explosives).

achievements.name: The floor is water
achievements.description: Complete Flooding without getting wet.

achievements.name: Where's my hammer?
achievements.description: Complete Making space without using any tools.

achievements.name: Swiss cheese
achievements.description: Complete An assortment of dishes without getting hit by the chopper.

achievements.name: Big brother
achievements.description: Complete Ornamental ordeal without getting seen by the robots.

achievements.name: Runner up
achievements.description: Complete The Chase without using any vehicles.

achievements.name: Summer is over
achievements.description: Reach part 2.

achievements.name: Tourist
achievements.description: Travel to Muratori.

achievements.name: Beat it
achievements.description: Complete the game.

achievements.name: Completionist
achievements.description: Complete the game with all optional targets.

achievements.name: Bare bones
achievements.description: Complete a mission without using any tools.

achievements.name: Meticulous planner
achievements.description: Spend a very long time in a mission before triggering anything ('Meticulous planner').

achievements.name: Speedrunner
achievements.description: Complete a mission very quickly - the first mission, 'The Old Building Problem', is easiest, trivial with the Rocket Launcher.

achievements.name: Wasn't me
achievements.description: Destroy 10 000 000 voxels.

achievements.name: Now what
achievements.description: Destroy 100 000 000 voxels.

achievements.name: I took a thing
achievements.description: Find 50 valuables.

achievements.name: True looter
achievements.description: Find 200 valuables.
